column4: cleat#2370: this job sets only CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL, so the postgres and mssql subtests' testutil.TestDB calls skip. Specific (contains "Test"), so it claims its own matches before the broad /postgres$ and /mssql$ lines in multi-db-ci-initial-measurement.tsv see them -- no bump needed there (cleat#2729's overlap resolution).
cleat#2370: this job sets only CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL, so the postgres and mysql subtests skip. Same reasoning as the multi-db/mysql line above, against the /postgres$ and /mysql$ broad lines.
cleat#2370: the cluster job sets only CLEAT_TEST_DB (postgres), so the mysql and mssql subtests skip. Same shape as every other dialect-parameterised test's cluster line in this ledger.

identical regex to the cluster line above, required by check-skips.sh so the scheduled engine-race.yml (postgres-only, same job-key) has its own pairing rather than relying on the per-PR cluster job alone.
